Name: DGA - Omori Items
Author: Kudoh1337228
Description:
[b][size=3]This is my very first mod. If you have any bugs, issues or ideas, please do give me feedback.
[/size]
[/b]This mod requires [b][size=3]DynamicGameAssets[/size][/b] and whatever dependencies that thing has.

Supported languages include[b] English [/b]and [b]Russian[/b]

Now, onto what this content pack contains:

[b][size=3]Weapons

[/size]Steak Knife [/b]- Sunny's/Omori's signature weapon. This is a Sword type weapon, however that might change in the future. Unlocked at level 6 combat. Needs to be crafted.

[b]Aubrey's Nailed Bat [/b]- Club type weapon. Unlocked at level 7 combat. Needs to be crafted.

[size=3][b]Food

[/b][/size][b]Orange Joe[/b] - Kel's favorite drink. Boosts your speed by a huge amount for a short while, gives energy. Comes at a cost of taking damage from drinking it. Unlocked at level 5 combat. Can be crafted. Also can be bought at Stardrop Saloon for 200g. Aubrey loves it for some reason.

[b]Hero Sandwich [/b]- Hero loves it. Maybe. +125 energy +56 health. Unlocked at level 3 farming. Needs to be cooked.

[size=3][b]Clothing

[/b][/size][b]Aubrey's Jacket [/b]- [i]CAREFUL!!![/i] This item may make your items [b]vanish[/b] when switching it with other items. It also doesn't work on female farmers, yeah i know i know. Im not sure how thats supposed to be fixed. May be a DGA-sided issue. Supposed to be made by tailoring but that isnt functional for now. Just use DGA console commands.


[size=3]If you dont want to wait to unlock or waste resources on these items you can just type [b]dga_store[/b] in the SMAPI console.[/size]
